name: Quick Command | Keyboard launcher for tabs, bookmarks & search
description: Jump to any tab, bookmark or search from the keyboard, on any page or from any app. Save and organize bookmarks too.

open-finder.description: Open Quick Command bookmarks (a popup window on vivaldi:// / Web Store pages)

open-tabs.description: Open the Quick Command tab switcher (a popup window on vivaldi:// / Web Store pages)

open-omni.description: Open Quick Command search (a popup window on vivaldi:// / Web Store pages)

open-save.description: Save this page with Quick Command (assign a key here to use it)

open-organize.description: Open the Quick Command organizer (a popup window on vivaldi:// / Web Store pages)

open-launch.description: Open the Quick Command launcher menu (assign a key here to use it)
